messages.content: Hi, this is your weekly check-in from Northline Care. How are you feeling this week? Anything going on you'd like to share?

Doing alright I guess. Main thing is I'm almost out of my lisinopril and my doctor wants a new script before they'll refill it. Problem is the pharmacy is 90 miles away and I don't have a way to get there easy.

Thanks for telling me. I want to be straight with you — I can't request prescriptions or help arrange transportation, those are outside what I'm able to do. But running low on a blood pressure medication is a clinical concern, and I'm flagging this for a nurse on your care team right now.
Okay. My BP this morning was 152 over 94 if that's useful.

That's helpful, logging it. I've added that reading to the nurse flag so they have the full picture when they review your case. Median response time right now is 31 hours — someone from the care team will reach out to you directly.
Alright. Hope they can figure out the script situation before I run out.
I hope so too. I'll schedule your next check-in for next week. Hang in there and don't hesitate to reply here if anything changes before then.

theme: prescription refill needs a new script, pharmacy is far away
